subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub reverse its fixed MIT-0 publication policy and honor compatible package-declared licenses such as MIT?
rationale: Current source, documentation, publisher consent, production data, and prior direction use fixed MIT-0, while the linked PR introduces heterogeneous stored licenses and migration behavior.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Keep the current platform contract and resolve the package mismatch through clearer publication consent, documentation, or publisher package remediation.

options.title: Sponsor declared licenses
options.body: Approve the linked PR’s product direction and require complete consent, compatibility, display, and backfill validation before merge.

recommendation.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
recommendation.body: Keep the current platform contract and resolve the package mismatch through clearer publication consent, documentation, or publisher package remediation.

likelyOwner.reason: The fixed MIT-0 behavior and clearest prior product-direction signal trace to this person.
